caption: The drawing depicts three main objects and one detail, each rendered with shades of green, gray, and black. On the left is a pair of long-handled tongs with decorative, bulbous handles and circular joint, colored in greenish tones with darker accents for shading. To the right of the tongs is a finial or ornamental knob shown in detail, colored similarly in green and shadowed with gray and black, with a scale beneath indicating its size as approximately 1 inch. On the far right is a fireplace shovel or spade, also rendered in greenish-gray, with a long, elegant handle similar in style to the tongs, and a wide, flat scoop at the end; there is a scale below this shovel, labeled in inches, with the scoop measuring around 5 inches across. All objects are outlined in black and set against a plain, off-white background, with the artist's name, "Hans Korsch," printed in the lower left corner.
title: Tongs and Shovel
